name: SEG
recent: SEG International 在 2026 年 11 月 19 日公布季度业绩，并宣布提供财务援助。新闻标题显示第三季度归属利润为 730 万令吉。近期公告还包括 10 月 6 日的财务援助事项。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 19 日公布最新季度业绩。
公司于 2026 年 11 月 19 日及 10 月 6 日公告提供财务援助。
earnings: 最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 5809.9 万令吉，环比下降 0.6%，同比增长 18.5%；净收入为 346.4 万令吉，环比增长 15.2%，同比增长 1302.4%；净利率为 6.0%，高于上一季度的 5.1%。

recent_en: SEG International announced its quarterly results and provision of financial assistance on 19 November 2026. News headlines indicate Q3 profit attributable of RM7.3 million. Recent announcements also include financial assistance on 6 October.
notable_en: The company released its latest quarterly results on 19 November 2026.
The company announced provision of financial assistance on 19 November 2026 and 6 October.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM58.099 million, down 0.6% QoQ but up 18.5% YoY; net income was RM3.464 million, up 15.2% QoQ and 1302.4% YoY; net margin was 6.0%, higher than 5.1% in the previous quarter.
